candidate_rule: First comma-separated name after each WNID; strip surrounding whitespace; preserve case and underscores; remove exact duplicate strings in source order.
target_rule: Each WNID maps to its first name; WNIDs with the same first name share the same target label.
metric_scope: Classification accuracy over sampled images, comparing validated predicted names with mapped target names.
image_pool_rule: Index every available image file under a recognized WNID directory, or every entry in a supplied relative-path-to-WNID index; do not subsample WNIDs when constructing the pool.
run_sampling_rule: Sample 1,000 distinct images uniformly without replacement from the indexed image pool in each run; samples may overlap across runs.
